title: Mommy Prays Too
vol: Mommy Is Human Too · Book Fourteen
verse: "Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God."

pages.text:
The bills were on the table, and the car had made a sound,
and Mommy's forehead wrinkled as she walked the kitchen round.

Jojo saw her rub her eyes. Pip saw her bite her lip.
And Baby Bee saw Mommy's coffee cooling, without a sip.

"Mommy, are you worried?" Jojo asked her, soft and low.
And Mommy sighed. "A little bit. I'm human too, you know."

Then Mommy went into her room and gently shut the door,
and Jojo peeked in through the crack — and saw her on the floor:

not hurt, not sad, but kneeling, with her hands held up in prayer,
and whispering to God above, who's always listening there.

"Lord, I don't have all the answers, and I can't fix everything.
But You can. So I'm giving You each worry that I bring."

Then Mommy wiped her eyes and stood, her shoulders not so tight.
She opened up the door and smiled. "Now Mommy feels all right."

"What were you doing?" Pip asked. "Praying," Mommy said.
"When grown-ups have big worries, we bring them to God instead."

"Do grown-ups have to pray?" asked Jojo. "Don't you know it all?"
"Oh, no," said Mommy, laughing. "Next to God, I'm very small.

I pray when I am worried, and I pray when I am glad.
I pray when things are wonderful, and when they're going bad."

"Can we pray with you?" asked Pip. So all of them knelt down —
Jojo, Pip, and Baby Bee, with Biscuit curled around.

Pip prayed the car would start again. Jojo prayed for Mommy's day.
And Baby Bee said, "Amen!" loud — her favorite word to say.

The worries didn't vanish all at once, but something new
was in the house — a peace that said, "God's taking care of you."

Because your Mommy worries, and she gives her worries too —
and Mommy needs to pray sometimes… because she's human too.

verses: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
